```{r, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)
library(htmltools)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
load("pca_objects.RData")

```

```{r part6,echo=TRUE}
# 載入主檔案存下的物件；找不到就說明原因
if (!exists("ref_name")) {
  rdata = "pca_objects.RData"
  if (!file.exists(rdata)) {
    stop("找不到 ", rdata, "。請先在主檔案 part5 最後執行 save(...)，",
         "並把檔案放到這個資料夾：", getwd())
  }
  load(rdata)
}
stopifnot(exists("strategies"), exists("analysis_data"), exists("pca_list"), exists("ref_name"))

main_name = ref_name                         # "D"
pca_main  = pca_list[[main_name]]
data_main = strategies[[main_name]]
stopifnot(nrow(data_main) == nrow(analysis_data))   # D 與 analysis_data 列數、順序相同

pal_status = c("原本有值" = "#2a78d6", "原本缺失" = "#eb6834")
pal_origin = c("EWR" = "#2a78d6", "JFK" = "#eb6834", "LGA" = "#1baf7a")

# ---------- 1. 負荷量圖：hover 看數值、點圖例篩選變數群組、與策略 A 對照 ----------
to_loading = function(p, ref_rot = NULL) {
  rot = p$rotation[, 1:5]
  if (!is.null(ref_rot)) {                  # 正負號對齊基準策略
    s = sign(colSums(rot * ref_rot)); s[s == 0] = 1
    rot = sweep(rot, 2, s, "*")
  }
  out = as.data.frame(rot %*% diag(p$sdev[1:5]))
  colnames(out) = paste0("PC", 1:5)
  out$variable = rownames(p$rotation)
  out
}
load_main = to_loading(pca_main)
load_A    = to_loading(pca_list$A, pca_main$rotation[, 1:5])
load_main$group = ifelse(load_main$variable %in% flight_vars, "飛行指標", "天氣指標")
load_main$A_PC1 = load_A$PC1
load_main$A_PC2 = load_A$PC2
load_main$zero  = 0
load_A$zero     = 0

load_main$hover = paste0("<b>", load_main$variable, "</b>",
                         "<br>策略 ", main_name, "：PC1 ", sprintf("%.2f", load_main$PC1),
                         "，PC2 ", sprintf("%.2f", load_main$PC2),
                         "<br>策略 A：PC1 ", sprintf("%.2f", load_main$A_PC1),
                         "，PC2 ", sprintf("%.2f", load_main$A_PC2))

circle = data.frame(x = cos(seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 200)),
                    y = sin(seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 200)))

loading_plot = plot_ly() %>%
  add_paths(data = circle, x = ~x, y = ~y, line = list(color = "grey80", dash = "dot"),
            hoverinfo = "none", showlegend = FALSE) %>%
  add_segments(data = load_A, x = ~zero, y = ~zero, xend = ~PC1, yend = ~PC2,
               line = list(color = "#eb6834", dash = "dash", width = 1.5),
               name = "策略 A（對照）", hoverinfo = "none") %>%
  add_segments(data = load_main, x = ~zero, y = ~zero, xend = ~PC1, yend = ~PC2,
               split = ~group, legendgroup = ~group, showlegend = FALSE,
               line = list(color = "#2a78d6", width = 2.5), hoverinfo = "none") %>%
  add_trace(data = load_main, x = ~PC1, y = ~PC2, type = "scatter", mode = "markers+text",
            split = ~group, legendgroup = ~group,
            text = ~variable, textposition = "top center",
            marker = list(size = 9, color = "#2a78d6"),
            hovertext = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text") %>%
  plotly::layout(title = paste0("策略 ", main_name, " 的負荷量（實線）vs 策略 A（虛線）"),
                 xaxis = list(title = "PC1 負荷量", range = c(-1.15, 1.15), zeroline = TRUE),
                 yaxis = list(title = "PC2 負荷量", range = c(-1.15, 1.15), zeroline = TRUE,
                              scaleanchor = "x", scaleratio = 1),
                 legend = list(title = list(text = "點圖例可隱藏")))
loading_plot

# 相似度（Tucker φ）：負荷量圖上兩組箭頭有多接近
round(abs(colSums(pca_list$A$rotation[, 1:5] * pca_main$rotation[, 1:5])), 3)

# ---------- 2. 準備分數資料 ----------
scores = data_main
scores$PC1 = pca_main$x[, 1]
scores$PC2 = pca_main$x[, 2]
scores$PC3 = pca_main$x[, 3]
scores$p_status = factor(ifelse(is.na(analysis_data$pressure), "原本缺失", "原本有值"),
                         levels = c("原本有值", "原本缺失"))
scores$season = factor(c("冬", "冬", "春", "春", "春", "夏", "夏", "夏", "秋", "秋", "秋", "冬")[scores$month_flight],
                       levels = c("冬", "春", "夏", "秋"))

scores$hover = paste0(
  "<b>", scores$origin, " → ", scores$dest, "</b>　", scores$carrier,
  "<br>日期：2013-", scores$month_flight, "-", scores$day_flight,
  "<br>抵達延誤：", scores$arr_delay, " 分　起飛延誤：", scores$dep_delay, " 分",
  "<br>濕度：", round(scores$humid, 1), "%　能見度：", round(scores$visib, 1), " mi",
  "<br>氣壓原始：", ifelse(is.na(analysis_data$pressure), "缺失", round(analysis_data$pressure, 1)),
  "　補值後：", round(scores$pressure, 1), " mb",
  "<br>PC1 ", round(scores$PC1, 2), "　PC2 ", round(scores$PC2, 2), "　PC3 ", round(scores$PC3, 2))

set.seed(123)
samp = scores[sample.int(nrow(scores), 6000), ]
samp$key = seq_len(nrow(samp))

# ---------- 3. 連動篩選 + 框選（crosstalk）----------
# 在分數圖上用 Box Select / Lasso 框選，右邊的月份與延誤直方圖只會亮起框內航班；
# 左邊的篩選器會同時作用在三張圖
shared = highlight_key(samp, ~key, group = "flights")

p_score = plot_ly(shared, x = ~PC1, y = ~PC2, color = ~p_status, colors = pal_status,
                  type = "scatter", mode = "markers", marker = list(size = 5, opacity = 0.55),
                  text = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text") %>%
  plotly::layout(xaxis = list(title = "PC1"), yaxis = list(title = "PC2"), dragmode = "select")

p_month = plot_ly(shared, x = ~month_flight, type = "histogram",
                  marker = list(color = "#b9c0c7"), showlegend = FALSE) %>%
  plotly::layout(xaxis = list(title = "月份", dtick = 1), yaxis = list(title = "航班數"))

p_delay = plot_ly(shared, x = ~arr_delay, type = "histogram", nbinsx = 60,
                  marker = list(color = "#b9c0c7"), showlegend = FALSE) %>%
  plotly::layout(xaxis = list(title = "抵達延誤（分）", range = c(-60, 240)), yaxis = list(title = "航班數"))

linked = subplot(p_score,
                 subplot(p_month, p_delay, nrows = 2, titleX = TRUE, titleY = TRUE, margin = 0.08),
                 widths = c(0.62, 0.38), titleX = TRUE, titleY = TRUE, margin = 0.05) %>%
  plotly::layout(title = "框選分數圖 → 看框內航班的月份與延誤") %>%
  highlight(on = "plotly_selected", off = "plotly_deselect",
            color = "#15191e", opacityDim = 0.25, persistent = FALSE)

dashboard = bscols(widths = c(3, 9),
                   list(
                     filter_checkbox("f_origin", "機場", shared, ~origin, inline = TRUE),
                     filter_select("f_month", "月份（可多選）", shared, ~month_flight),
                     filter_checkbox("f_status", "氣壓原始狀態", shared, ~p_status),
                     filter_slider("f_pc1", "PC1 範圍", shared, ~PC1, step = 0.5)
                   ),
                   linked)
dashboard

# 存成可分享的 HTML（作業的「已發佈 dashboard」可以用這個檔，或用 RPubs 發佈）
save_html(dashboard, "pca_interactive_dashboard.html")

# ---------- 4. 依子群體切開（small multiples）----------
facet_plot = function(var, title) {
  samp %>%
    split(samp[[var]]) %>%
    lapply(function(d) {
      plot_ly(d, x = ~PC1, y = ~PC2, color = ~p_status, colors = pal_status,
              type = "scatter", mode = "markers", marker = list(size = 4, opacity = 0.5),
              text = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text", legendgroup = ~p_status,
              showlegend = identical(as.character(d[[var]][1]),
                                     as.character(sort(unique(samp[[var]]))[1]))) %>%
        plotly::layout(annotations = list(list(text = paste0("<b>", d[[var]][1], "</b>　n=", nrow(d)),
                                               xref = "paper", yref = "paper", x = 0, y = 1.08,
                                               showarrow = FALSE, xanchor = "left")))
    }) %>%
    subplot(nrows = 1, shareX = TRUE, shareY = TRUE, titleX = TRUE) %>%
    plotly::layout(title = title)
}
facet_plot("p_status", "依氣壓原始狀態切開：缺失組集中在 PC1 右側")
facet_plot("origin",   "依機場切開：三個機場的缺失圖樣一致")
facet_plot("season",   "依季節切開：PC1 高分集中在夏季")

# ---------- 5. 用數字驗證互動操作看到的現象（全資料，不是抽樣）----------
# Q3：缺失組在 PC1 的位置
aggregate(cbind(PC1, PC2, arr_delay, humid) ~ p_status, data = scores, FUN = mean)
tapply(scores$PC1 > 1, scores$p_status, mean)                 # PC1 > 1 的比例

# Q4：三個機場是否一致；PC2 為何分開
aggregate(cbind(PC1, arr_delay) ~ origin + p_status, data = scores, FUN = mean)
aggregate(cbind(PC2, distance) ~ origin, data = scores, FUN = mean)

# Q5：固定 LGA、5 月
lga_may = subset(scores, origin == "LGA" & month_flight == 5)
table(lga_may$p_status)
aggregate(cbind(PC1, arr_delay, humid) ~ p_status, data = lga_may, FUN = mean)

# Q6：框選 PC1 > 2 的航班
hi = subset(scores, PC1 > 2)
c(航班數 = nrow(hi), 原本缺失比例 = mean(hi$p_status == "原本缺失") * 100,
  抵達延誤平均 = mean(hi$arr_delay), 濕度平均 = mean(hi$humid), 能見度平均 = mean(hi$visib))
round(prop.table(table(hi$month_flight)) * 100, 1)

# Q7：框選 PC3 < -2 的航班（低溫型延誤）
lo3 = subset(scores, PC3 < -2)
c(航班數 = nrow(lo3), 抵達延誤平均 = mean(lo3$arr_delay), 氣溫平均 = mean(lo3$temp))
round(prop.table(table(lo3$month_flight)) * 100, 1)
